title.label: Awesome blocky game! Money well spent, just want a little more weather stuff.

content.label: Hello Minecraft! I love this game and all the features, but I would love some more weather stuff. Like a snowstorm in any of the icy cold biomes, or a dust devil in the desert area, and it could give the players around it a drought effect and it could make the players weakened and dizzy. Or different lighting varients, like atmospheric lighting or instead of lighting striking down, it can spread out and hit different objects. Also, can you guys add red lighting. It could be very cool. Lightning can also give you the static effect and makes you take damage every 2 seconds and blinds your screen with lightning around it. Can you make all these effects in the command menu too? Also tornados, waterspouts, and hurricanes can be awesome. The tornados can make you dizzy and the waterspouts can launch the players into the sky. And the hurricanes can drag the players into the ocean floors and you can only escape with ender pearls or you can clutch. Also, it would be nice to have a pretty rainbow and if you find one you can go to the end of it and find a chest or cauldron with gold and diamonds! And if you suck up a part of the rainbow then you’ll get a lucky potion that you can drink to get the lucky effect and if you drink it, then you’ll get one extra ore of any kind, even netherite! It can last for 2 min, 8 min, 10 min, 15 min, and 20 min. You’ll also do a little more damage and the mobs and players you hit will get a highlighted border. It could also be cool if there could be a high wind event that will make you slippery. If you want to not slip then you can milk a slime for the sticky bucket, then you can drink it to not slip on any slippery surface.  It would also be AWESOME to add quick sand for some traps and a sinkhole for some desert updates. In order to get quicksand, you’ll need a silk touch tool, like an axe, shovel, (ideal), or a pickaxe. There could also be the Northern lights in any icy biome. Maybe some heatwaves could be cool, it could last 6 minutes or 1 Minecraft day and if you don’t get out of the heatwave (75-150 blocks), then you’ll take half a heart every 1.37 seconds. There’ll be a new meter, like the drown meter but it will be a flame symbol and it will tick down to ZERO. It could be cool to see some optical phenomena, like sun dogs, atmospheric halos, and iredescence. I would also love a dust storm that can make you blind with dust and make you slow. You can make a glass bottle to gather up some dust then you can splash or drink the potion then it will make you slow and blinded with dust. Thanks for the awesome game and daily updates!
